_comment: paper_minimum_threshold_8b_16gb_resume.json, extended: decision training continues past 2500 to 4000.
At 2000 the decision model was still improving (accuracy 0.79, validation loss still falling), so 2500 steps
was not enough to learn the persona weights. A resume may grow training_steps and change introspection
points after the step it resumes from; everything up to that step is kept (README 'Resuming a run').
In run_experiment.ipynb: SETTINGS_FILE = this file, RESUME_RUN_ID = the run's id, RESUME_FROM_STEP = 2500
(after the current run finishes). Introspection branches again at 3000 and 4000.
